articles.title: Siddal ARLFC to Host Rochdale Mayfield in Home Fixture
articles.excerpt: Siddal ARLFC will host Rochdale Mayfield in a home league fixture tomorrow, with a kick-off at 2pm. Head Coach Mikey Otty has named his squad for the match, which will take place at Siddal ARLFC.
articles.content_html:
Siddal ARLFC will host Rochdale Mayfield in a home league fixture tomorrow. Head Coach Mikey Otty has named his squad for the match, which is set to kick off at 2pm.

The game will take place at Siddal ARLFC, with The Firepit in Halifax serving as the match day sponsor. Fans are encouraged to attend, with a suggested donation of £2 for entry.

This fixture is part of the ongoing league season, and both teams will be looking to secure valuable points as they compete for standings in the league. Supporters are reminded to arrive early to enjoy the pre-match atmosphere and support their teams.

The match is expected to draw a local crowd, contributing to the community's engagement with the sport and providing an opportunity for fans to rally behind their teams.
